author: GameTrailers
description: Don't miss the Closed Beta Overview Trailer for Hunger, a first-person multiplayer extraction looter shooter developed by Good Fun Corporation. Players will embark on dangerous expeditions to master short-range and long-range combat, secure resources, and take on the trials and tribulations of a plague-ridden Europe. Get the rundown on the next closed beta for Hunger, running from October 19 through October 26 for PC (Steam).
title: Hunger - Official Closed Beta Overview Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Don't miss the Skyborne Lore & Abilities Overview Trailer for World of Warcraft: Forever, an upcoming MMO RPG developed by Blizzard Entertainment. Players can get the rundown of the new playable race, with the Skyborne making their debut in World of Warcraft: Forever. Get the backstory of the Skyborne in World of Warcraft: Forever, launching on November 6 for PC.
title: World of Warcraft: Forever - Official Skyborne Lore & Abilities Overview Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Don't miss the Season 5: A Grim Doctrine Launch Trailer for Overwatch, a first-person team-based hero shooter developed by Blizzard Entertainment. Players can get an extensive look at Doctrine, the latest Support Hero being added to the game. Doctrine can manipulate life using his Eternal Scepter and mechanical drones, alongside turning the tide of battle with his Infuse ability. Take a look at what's in store with Season 5 of Overwatch, launching on October 6 for PlayStation 4 (PS4), PlayStation 5 (PS5), Xbox One, Xbox Series X|S, Nintendo Switch, Nintendo Switch 2, and PC (Steam and Battle.net).
title: Overwatch - Official Season 5: A Grim Doctrine Launch Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Check out the Announcement Trailer for BrokenLore: MIKI-CHAN, a psychological horror adventure game developed by Serafini Productions. Players will interact with a virtual assistant named MIKI-CHAN that seeps into themes of jealousy, obsession, and more as the player faces a series of psychological trials and horror itself. BrokenLore: MIKI-CHAN is coming soon to PlayStation 5 (PS5), Xbox Series X|S, and PC (Steam and Epic Games Store).
title: BrokenLore: MIKI-CHAN - Official Announcement Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Don't miss the Gameplay Trailer for Broken Horror Anthology, a collection of atmospheric horror games developed by Shikami, EpicSUS, Basement Tapes, and Neuron Activation Games. Players will observe toys to check for oddities, seek a faint radio signal, and more across these diverse yet horrifying experiences. Broke Horror Anthology is launching on November 12 for PC (Steam).
title: Broken Horror Anthology - Official Gameplay Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Don't miss the 'Meet Larson' Overview Trailer for Tomb Raider: Legacy of Atlantis, an upcoming remake of the original action-adventure game developed by Crystal Dynamics and Flying Wild Hog. Players can take a look at the process of Bradley Snedeker taking on the role of Larson Conway. Meet Larson in Tomb Raider: Legacy of Atlantis, launching on February 12, 2027, for PlayStation 5 (PS5), Xbox Series X|S, Nintendo Switch 2, and PC (Steam).
title: Tomb Raider: Legacy of Atlantis - Official 'Meet Larson' Overview Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Don't miss the Trailer for Black Tides Draga's Wake, an upcoming third-person action horror shooter developed by Strange Creature Factory. Players will embody a smuggler trapped in a steamship on the brink of oblivion in an alternate 1900s timeline. Take on cosmic entities as an ancient God takes hold of the smuggler's body in Black Tides Draga's Wake, coming soon to PlayStation 5 (PS5), Xbox Series X|S, and PC (Steam).
title: Black Tides Draga's Wake - Official Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Get a look at the 'DMZ: Addition of Extraction' From The Ward Ep. 7 Video for Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4, the next installment in the first-person shooter franchise developed by Infinity Ward. Players can get an extensive behind-the-scenes look at the improvements to the new DMZ for Modern Warfare 4 and a reflection on the original DMZ Beta. Play DMZ in Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4, launching on October 23 for PlayStation 5 (PS5), Xbox Series X|S, and PC (Steam).
title: Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4 - Official 'DMZ: Addition of Extraction' From The Ward Ep. 7 Video

author: GameTrailers
description: Check out the Solace Ability Gameplay Trailer for March of Giants, a free-to-play strategy MOBA developed by March of Giants Team. Players can get the rundown on Solace's abilities, who can heal allies, convert enemy soldiers, and wield powers of the divine in any engagement. March of Giants is coming soon to PC (Steam), with a playtest available now on Steam.
title: March of Giants - Official Solace Ability Gameplay Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Don't miss the Boss Challenge Trailer for Stellar Blade, the hit third-person action game developed by Shift Up. Players can put their skills to the test with the Boss Challenge Mode, putting them head-to-head with bosses from the main game back-to-back. Take on bosses in Stellar Blade, launching on November 5 for Nintendo Switch 2, with the game being available now for PlayStation 5 (PS5) and PC (Steam).
title: Stellar Blade - Official Boss Challenge Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Take a look at the Demo Launch Trailer for Guns of Eschaton, a first-person action soulslike shooter developed by Eschatology Entertainment. Players will traverse an apocalyptic Wild West to take on enemies, block hits, and use precious bullets wisely to survive the unforgiving frontier. Guns of Eschaton is coming soon to PlayStation 5 (PS5), Xbox Series X|S, and PC (Steam), with a demo available now on Steam.
title: Guns of Eschaton - Official Demo Launch Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Check out the Waves of Lead Update Launch Trailer for World War Z, the hit third-person action zombie shooter developed by Saber Interactive. Players will continue the fight against the horde with an all-new content update with five new mutators, six new heavy weapon perks, three unlockable custom frames, and the new double-barreled Bullpup Shotgun and Gas Pipe Wrench melee weapon. The Waves of Lead Update is available now for World War Z on PlayStation 4 (PS4), PlayStation 5 (PS5), Xbox One, Xbox Series X|S, and PC (Steam and Epic Games Store).
title: World War Z - Official Waves of Lead Update Launch Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description:
Revenge is coming. Watch the latest Halloween: The Game trailer to see the reveal of the upcoming Halloween 5: The Revenge of Michael Myers DLC for the asymmetrical action-horror game. Halloween: The Game is available now on PlayStation 5 (PS5), Xbox Series X/S, and PC (Steam and Epic Games Store). 

The Halloween 5: The Revenge of Michael Myers DLC features new Michael Myers skins, including the version of Michael from Halloween 5: The Return of Michael Myers and the version of Michael from Halloween 2018. A new map will be added, inspired by the settings of Halloween 5, the Tower Farm Map, where worn country roads meet at the center of a small, quaint farming community just outside of Haddonfield. Additionally, two new Civilians, a special Halloween costume pack, and more will be introduced in the first of a series of post-launch content updates for Halloween: The Game which will be carried out across the first year.

The Halloween 5: The Revenge of Michael Myers DLC will be availab
title: Halloween: The Game - Official Halloween 5: The Revenge of Michael Myers DLC Reveal Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Frostpunk is coming to Nintendo Switch and Nintendo Switch 2 on October 19, 2026. Get another look at Frostpunk in this trailer for the society survival game. In Frostpunk, take the helm as the ruler of the last city on Earth, and guide New London's flock to survival through their own harsh moral choices.
title: Frostpunk - Official Nintendo Switch Release Date Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Get a look at the Demo Launch Trailer for Lenin Street Geek Shop, a stylized shop-keeping management game developed by Perelesoq. Players will manage the day-to-day operations of a small snowy town's first geek shop, from stocking shelves, tending to customer needs, and growing the store. Lenin Street Geek Shop is coming soon to PC (Steam), with a demo available now on Steam.
title: Lenin Street Geek Shop - Official Demo Launch Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Get another look at the sci-fi world and gameplay of Silicone Heart in this latest trailer for the upcoming cozy farming and automation adventure game. In Silicone Heart, build a self-sustaining cyber farm on a planet-sized junkyard. Grow biomechanical crops, automate production, repair discarded robots, and secretly reshape a mechanical society from the inside. Silicone Heart will be available on PC on December 1, 2026. A demo is out now on Steam.
title: Silicone Heart - Official Demo Trailer
